capitalOfTheWorld.name: The Capital of the World
capitalOfTheWorld.note: Your seat of government holds the citizens, the buildings and the wonder, all at once.

workedLand.name: The Worked Land
workedLand.note: Everything the land around your seat of government pays you, added up over the age.

theHarvest.name: The Harvest
deferred: The food a farm pays is not yet told apart from the food the ground under it pays, so nothing can read this bar.
theHarvest.note: Food paid by your farms, in one turn, across the realm.

breadAndIron.name: Bread and Iron
breadAndIron.note: The fields and the levy at once: food to spare every turn, and an army in the field.

caravanserai.name: The Caravanserai
caravanserai.note: Everything your roads and your caravans pay you, added up over the age.

kingsRoads.name: The King's Roads
kingsRoads.note: The gold your towns pay for being joined to your seat of government, added up over the age.

solventRealm.name: The Solvent Realm
solventRealm.note: Everything your treasury took in over the age, less what the realm cost to keep.

warChest.name: The War Chest
warChest.note: Gold in hand and an army in the field, on the same turn.

academies.name: The Academies
academies.note: Everything your scholars learned over the age, added up.

observatory.name: The Observatory
observatory.note: Learning for each citizen you keep — a wide realm of unschooled towns will not reach it.

theTithe.name: The Tithe
theTithe.note: Everything your faith pays the realm, added up over the age.

wonderOfTheAge.name: The Wonder of the Age
wonderOfTheAge.note: Wonders of this very age standing in your towns.

marvelsPay.name: The Marvels' Pay
marvelsPay.note: Everything your wonders pay you, added up over the age.

patronage.name: The Patronage
patronage.note: Everything your great people pay you — their works, their boons and their legacies — added up over the age.

theRenowned.name: The Renowned
theRenowned.note: All the renown your realm earned over the age, whether or not you spent it.

theChronicle.name: The Chronicle
theChronicle.note: All the culture your realm made over the age, added up.

theDeck.name: The Deck
theDeck.note: Everything the cards in your chairs pay you, added up over the age.

marcherLords.name: The Marcher Lords
marcherLords.note: A wide realm that is neither discontented nor overstretched.

theBuilders.name: The Builders
theBuilders.note: Everything the buildings of your realm pay you in one turn.

sixVoices.name: The Six Voices
sixVoices.note: Food, work, gold, learning, culture and faith together, added up over the age — nothing neglected.

contentedRealm.name: The Contented Realm
contentedRealm.note: Contentment to spare, counted every turn of the age and added up.

theArsenal.name: The Arsenal
deferred: The work a town puts behind a soldier is not counted apart from the rest of its work, so nothing can read this bar.
theArsenal.note: Work put into soldiers over the age, across the realm.

fieldOfGlory.name: The Field of Glory
fieldOfGlory.note: Rivals' soldiers killed over the age, less your own lost — the exchange, not the body count.

takenTown.name: The Taken Town
takenTown.note: Towns you took by force this age and still hold.
